'''Asharl panthers''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found on numerous [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Pack animals, they formed small family groups and hunted in pairs or groups of four.

==Biology and appearance==
Feline quadrupeds, the asharl panther was a large and aggressive predator found on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. With an appearance akin to the [[jaggalor]]s of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the average panther grew between two and three meters in length as an adult, and had two toes on each foot tipped with non-retractable claws. To maintain body heat on the harsh planet of Ilum, asharl had evolved [[Color/Legends|white]], gray, and blue fur which was incredibly dense, yet smooth, across their entire bodies. Their heads were broad an they lacked ears, while their beady eyes were located beneath pronounced brow ridges. Expressive, the asharl's snout was blunt and their hall filled with large exposed [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Large, tentacle-like sensory organs grew from their shoulders, one on each side.<ref name="NoP" /> Thick nerve bundles ran up the fronds from which the panthers could pick up the vibrations that came from behind, preventing any threat from catching the asharl unawares.

Asharl panthers were known to enjoy the taste of meat from the [[Blismal/Legends|blismal]], a [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] native to Ilum.<ref name="TOR:PantherTraining">{{TORcite|type=daily|Panther Training|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

==Asharl panthers in culture==
A popular game animal on planets beyond Ilum, the asharl were prized for their pelts and fronds by poachers who sought to sell them on the black market. The asharl panther was adopted as a mascot of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Rodarch]]. Its members trained to fight alongside the animals, and painted their [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] to match the panthers' pelts. The Rodarch clan completely embraced the essence of these animals, making its members look like fearless beasts who were always aware of their surrounding.<ref name="TOR" />
